blocks.text: All proceeds from the sale of vehicles under this chapter shall go first towards satisfying the towing, storing, publication and other expenses of the City, with the surplus, if any, going to the special street repair fund of the City. (Code 1981 § 43-408. Code 1995 § 142-272.)
